entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Beings not of this world, whose minds the people of Zendikar cannot comprehend; the column likens them to a vast, mind-paralyzing presence.

entities.name: Emrakul, the Aeons Torn
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan, described as a vast manifestation of a mind-paralyzing smack-down when seen up close.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: The world whose native population tried to understand the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Kor
entities.description: A native people of Zendikar who tried to understand and defeat the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Merfolk
entities.description: A native people of Zendikar who tried to understand and defeat the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Vampires
entities.description: A native people of Zendikar who tried to understand and defeat the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Gaddock Teeg
entities.description: A key character in the Lorwyn set and a cenn of his tribe, depicted by Greg Staples as a powerful and serious kithkin.

entities.name: Ashnod
entities.description: A figure whose card flavor says she found few willing to trade their humanity for the power she offered.

entities.name: Lorwyn
entities.description: The world of the set in which Gaddock Teeg is a key character.

events.summary: The native peoples of Zendikar, the Kor, merfolk and vampires, try to understand the Eldrazi and how to defeat them.
events.quote: The Kor, merfolk, and vampires all tried to understand and figure out what the Eldrazi were and how could they defeat them.

relations.note: The Kor tried to figure out how to defeat the Eldrazi.
